manufacturing.basis: Figure 03 is documented at an external customer manufacturing site (BMW Group Plant Spartanburg, Hall 52, an assembly and logistics hall) under the robot's PILOT status. Score left NULL: arrival is documented, Figure 03 task results are not.

home.basis: Figure states Figure 03 is designed for the home and describes home-specific design work (cluttered-space perception, battery safety in a home environment, washable soft goods). Fit on manufacturer design positioning only, score NULL, confidence LOW.

warehouse-logistics.basis: The Catalyst Brands distribution and logistics agreement names 'Figure humanoids', not Figure 03; the BMW hall is described as assembly and logistics without stating Figure 03 performs logistics tasks. Plausible, not yet attributable to this model.

retail-service.basis: Figure describes Figure 03 as suited to commercial environments (navigation, pick and place, fleet uniforms) but names no retail or service setting and records no such deployment.

research-education.basis: No developer edition, SDK, API or research/education programme is recorded for Figure 03 (has_sdk, has_api, developer_edition are NULL).

events-entertainment.basis: Nothing recorded links Figure 03 to events or entertainment use.

healthcare-rehabilitation.basis: Nothing recorded links Figure 03 to healthcare or rehabilitation; no clinical validation or regulatory approval is recorded.
